fact: The JPLG report says FMIS was deployed in five Puntland districts (Bossaso, Gardo, Galkayo, Garowe, Burtinle) over AIMS/BIMS records, five districts use mobile tax payment for property, business licence and transport taxes, and registered properties in Baidoa were being integrated into the South West state FMIS.
title: UN Joint Programme on Local Governance: Semi-Annual Progress Report, January-June 2021
publisher: UNDP Multi-Partner Trust Fund / Joint Programme on Local Governance
